subject: Renewal kickoff: Aurora Systems — capacity uplift, governance checklist & QBR slots
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Pierce <alex.pierce@aurorasystems.com>, Jamie Lopez <jamie.lopez@aurorasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: Aurora Systems — capacity uplift, governance checklist & QBR slots

Hi Alex / Jamie —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our conversation, I want to kick off the formal renewal/expansion planning so we have a single source of truth for owners, milestones, and the QBR schedule. High level asks below and next steps.

Summary of the ask
- Renewal window: contract renewal target 2028-07-31.
- Proposed uplift: +40% throughput (reserved capacity) to cover new ML use cases.
- Governance: Aurora requires SOC2 evidence and a short runbook for incident escalation.

Immediate next steps (owners)
1) Confirm renewal decision and budget owner — Alex (Aurora) — by 2028-06-16.
2) Tech/Capacity alignment call — Connor (Redwood) + Aurora infra — week of 6/19. I’ll send a Doodle; attached is a draft runbook and capacity plan.
3) Legal/MA P redlines — Marissa (Redwood) coordinating with Aurora legal; please review the attached MA P_Diff_v3.pdf and flag must-haves by 6/16.
4) QBR scheduling — we’ve attached a short slot poll (QBR_slot_poll.ics). Please mark availability; preference: wk of 7/11 so we can lock the final pre-renewal runbook.

Attachments: Aurora_Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (draft runbook), MA P_Diff_v3.pdf (redline), QBR_slot_poll.ics

I’ll follow up with the capacity call invite once we get confirm on budget and availability. If there are any blockers on SOC2 evidence, loop in David and I can expedite with our security team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this aligned.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Pierce <alex.pierce@aurorasystems.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Lopez <jamie.lopez@aurorasystems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Aurora Systems — capacity uplift, governance checklist & QBR slots

Kimberly —

Thanks for the concise outline. Quick answers:
- Budget owner is me; I can confirm pending a final capacity run and MA P clarifications by 6/16.
- SOC2 evidence: we need the auditor contact + expected delivery timeline. Can David share the SOC2 folder and the last report date?
- QBR week: wk of 7/11 works for our execs; earliest preference is Tues 7/12 afternoon PT.

We reviewed the MA P redline and have two open asks on data residency language — will send our legal comments by EOD 6/13.

Alex
VP, Platform Engineering | Aurora Systems
alex.pierce@aurorasystems.com | +1 (206) 555-2121

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Aurora Systems — capacity uplift, governance checklist & QBR slots

Alex / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I’ll sync with legal and put the redline tracker together — expect an initial response with line-level commentary by 6/14, final comments on data residency by 6/16 as requested.

Connor — can you schedule the technical alignment for 6/20 or 6/21 (UTC-friendly for Aurora)? I propose we use the attached draft playbook as the run of show; we should cover: traffic profile, KV cache expectations for the uplift, and an autoscale test window. I’ve added a short checklist to the playbook for what Aurora needs to validate on their side.

Kimberly — I flagged the SOC2 request and asked David to provide the secure link to the report and the auditor contact.

—Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Aurora Systems — capacity uplift, governance checklist & QBR slots

Thanks all — scheduling note below and a couple of technical prep items.

Proposed tech alignment: Tue 2028-06-20 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET — 60 min (calendar invite to follow).
Agenda (30/30):
- 30 min: Aurora traffic profile & expected burst patterns (Alex/Jamie)
- 30 min: Redwood uplift configuration, autoscale test plan, rollback strategy (Connor/David)

Pre-reads (please review before the call): Aurora_Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf — especially pages 4-7 (burst model) and page 11 (KV cache guidance).

David — can you post the SOC2 link here and share the auditor contact? Alex requested the timeline so they can align their compliance gate.

If the proposed time conflicts, tell me your preferred windows on 6/20 or 6/21 and I’ll adjust.

Connor O'Brien
